master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production complete loaded vehicle for prairie-star-13. Forest green conventional DAY CAB with chrome bull bar and air horns, flatbed semi-trailer securely loaded with strapped sawn lumber packs. Tractor AND semi-trailer together as ONE vehicle. EXACTLY FIVE near-side road wheels: ONE steer at RIGHT beneath conventional cab, CLOSE DRIVE TANDEM beneath hitch just behind cab, CLOSE TRAILER TANDEM at LEFT beneath rear of load. Each tandem nearly tire-to-tire with tiny gaps; no single lone rear trailer axle. Tire diameter 1.45m, blocky off-road ALL-TERRAIN tread with fine sipes, no chains or spikes. Overall loaded length 10.5 TIRE DIAMETERS (15.225m) and never16.8m or longer. Road tires about9.5% of total loaded length. Long slender rig; no oversized tires. All tires identical and perfectly round, centres level, chassis and trailer horizontal. All fixed chassis, deck, steps, tank, mudflaps and load must END ABOVE HUB LINE; only road tires below hubs. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Facing right. Visible short bonnet with distinct radiator housing, blunt bumper, headlamp and fender; round front arches following tire clearance; small rectangular mirrors on short rigid brackets near door. No visible front grille face. Clean plausible panels and seams. Polished paint with road dust, premium semi-realistic painted game illustration matching Swamp Scout; rich materials, fine mechanical details and dark contours. Soft even daylight. True transparent background/internal gaps, generous clear margins on all four sides. No ground shadow, glow, halo, checkerboard, text, logos or watermark. Intended2048x1024PNG. Match selected wheel input. Use horizontal slender proportions: loaded length1700px, road tire162px. Important trailer tandem and drive tandem are separate close sets; load sits over both sets.
